# owner: platform
"""Find the stretches of opening hours that nobody is covering."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.parsing import format_span
from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.merging import merge_spans


def find_gaps(worked: Iterable[Span], opening: Span) -> List[str]:
    """One label per uncovered stretch, such as gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min).

    Raises ValueError if any worked span is outside opening hours.
    """
    spans = list(worked)
    for span in spans:
        if span.start < opening.start or span.end > opening.end:
            raise ValueError(
                f"{format_span(span)} is outside opening hours "
                f"{format_span(opening)}"
            )

    labels = []
    cursor = opening.start
    for span in merge_spans(spans):
        if span.start > cursor:
            labels.append(_label(Span(cursor, span.start)))
        cursor = span.end
    if cursor < opening.end:
        labels.append(_label(Span(cursor, opening.end)))
    return labels


def _label(gap: Span) -> str:
    return f"gap {format_span(gap)} ({gap.minutes} min)"
EOF

# owner: platform
import unittest

from hourglass.parsing import parse_span
from hourglass.gaps import find_gaps


class GapTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gap_in_the_middle(self):
        """A lunch break between two shifts is reported."""
        worked = [parse_span("09:00-12:00"), parse_span("13:00-17:00")]
        result = find_gaps(worked, parse_span("09:00-17:00"))
        self.assertTrue(result == ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_gaps_at_both_ends(self):
        """Uncovered time before and after the shifts is reported."""
        result = find_gaps(
            [parse_span("10:00-11:00")], parse_span("09:00-12:00")
        )
        self.assertTrue(
            result
            == [
                "gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)",
                "gap 11:00-12:00 (60 min)",
            ]
        )

    def test_overlapping_spans_leave_no_gap(self):
        """Overlapping and touching shifts cover the whole day."""
        worked = [
            parse_span("13:00-17:00"),
            parse_span("09:00-14:00"),
            parse_span("14:00-15:00"),
        ]
        result = find_gaps(worked, parse_span("09:00-17:00"))
        self.assertTrue(result == [])

    def test_nobody_working(self):
        """With no shifts the whole opening span is one gap."""
        result = find_gaps([], parse_span("09:00-10:30"))
        self.assertTrue(result == ["gap 09:00-10:30 (90 min)"])

    def test_span_outside_opening_hours(self):
        """A shift starting before opening raises ValueError."""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            find_gaps(
                [parse_span("08:00-10:00")], parse_span("09:00-17:00")
            )

    def test_span_running_past_closing(self):
        """A shift ending after closing raises ValueError."""
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            find_gaps(
                [parse_span("16:00-18:00")], parse_span("09:00-17:00")
            )
EOF

- Add format_day_line and day_coverage.

before.docs/api.txt:
hourglass.parsing.parse_clock(text): read a clock time as minutes since midnight
hourglass.parsing.format_clock(minutes): minutes since midnight as HH:MM
hourglass.parsing.parse_span(text): read a range such as 09:00-17:30
hourglass.parsing.format_span(span): a span as start-end text
hourglass.parsing.normalize_day(text): short lowercase day name
hourglass.merging.spans_overlap(first, second): whether two spans share any time
hourglass.merging.intersect_spans(first, second): the part two spans share
hourglass.merging.merge_spans(spans): collapse overlaps into a sorted list
hourglass.merging.total_minutes(spans): minutes covered, overlaps counted once
hourglass.schedule.parse_schedule_text(text): parse schedule CSV held in memory
hourglass.schedule.load_schedule(path): read a schedule CSV from disk
hourglass.schedule.shifts_for_worker(shifts, worker): all shifts for one worker
hourglass.schedule.worker_minutes(shifts): scheduled minutes per worker
hourglass.schedule.day_coverage(shifts, day): merged spans for a day
hourglass.schedule.format_day_line(shifts, day): one text line for a day
